items.title: Verizon Yields 6.2%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap or a Retirement Bargain?
items.summary: A yield this high usually means Wall Street smells a cut, and Verizon is carrying $166 billion in debt after the Frontier deal. Yet one cash flow number and a bold new strategy from the CEO complicate the bear case for income-hungry retirees.

items.title: Charter Is Cutting $2 Billion in Costs After Losing Another 233,000 Internet Customers
items.summary: Wall Street punished Charter even as it promised billions in savings. The market wants proof that broadband customers are coming back, and the gap between the plan and the quarterly results explains why investors refused to wait.

items.title: Musk Says SpaceX Could Buy a Legacy Telco and Use Its Spectrum 10 Times Better
items.summary: Musk hinted at a telecom takeover without naming a target, while a rival CEO put a staggering price on SpaceX's ambitions. Debt, regulators, and a spectrum gap stand between the boast and a real deal.

items.title: T-Mobile launches new internet plan after customer losses
items.summary: T-Mobile is making a move in a competitive broadband market as it works to address a growing challenge with its customers.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 31% in a Month on SpaceX’s Tower Push: “We’re Talking to All Parties”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle (CCI) stock surged 31% from October 2 to November 2, closing at $87. 03 as SpaceX (SPCX) pursued wireless spectrum and potential tower leases.
